(2) The scene transitions to a medium shot where the drummer smiles broadly while performing. She executes a series of rapid-fire hits across the cymbals and tom-toms. In the background, pedestrians in casual outerwear walk past brightly lit storefronts and neon signs. (3) A sequence of close-up shots emphasizes the physical interaction between the wooden drumsticks and the metallic cymbals. The lighting is high-contrast, provided by artificial city lights, highlighting the reflective surfaces of the instruments and the drummer's energetic hand movements. (4) The camera pans slightly to show the full kit setup as the drummer continues her high-energy performance. Her posture is upright and dynamic, frequently leaning into the crashes. The surrounding environment remains a busy night square with soft bokeh background elements.
